references.text: Abraham's servant's original prayer to God where he asks for a sign at the well – verse 43 is the retelling of this prayer to Rebekah's family.
Rachel comes to the well with her father's sheep and meets Jacob – a type-scene that mirrors the meeting at the well in Genesis 24.
Moses meets Zipporah at the well, where she draws water for her father Reuel's small livestock. This is a parallel well-meeting scene as in Genesis 24.
Isaiah uses the same Hebrew word 'almah' (עַלְמָה) – a young woman/virgin – as in Genesis 24:43, an important lexical connection.
Jesus meets the Samaritan woman at the well and asks for water, a scene that can be seen as a spiritual parallel to the well meetings in the Old Testament.
